column3: 少し休憩中のランス達、シィルとお茶している所
column4: Rance and the others take a short break, drinking tea with Sill.

column3: ダークランスが現れる、ランスには関係ないとマリアと会う
column4: Dark Rance appears, but it doesn't concern Rance; he meets with Maria.

column3: 前に欲しいとか言っていただろ、偶然そこで拾ったから要るかなぁとヒララ鉱石
column4: You said you wanted one before, right? I happened to find this Hirara ore there, thought you might want it.

column3: いつも話を聞かせてもらっているしお礼だ
column4: You always listen to my stories, so this is a thank you.

column3: フェリスにも、何か渡す
column4: He also gives something to Feliss.

column3: お父様の俺には何かないのか？　魔物大将軍を倒す活躍をしたのだぞ
column4: Isn't there something for me, as a father? I made a great achievement defeating the Great Monster General.

column3: ちょっと考えて悪い事を思いつく
column4: Thinking a bit, he comes up with a bad idea.

column3: 俺達は、もう少しここで休憩している、３０分後、俺のテントに来い
column4: We'll rest here a little longer. Come to my tent in 30 minutes.

column3: お前は俺を父として尊敬しなさすぎだ、俺が大切な事を教えてやる
column4: You don't respect me enough as your father. I'll teach you something important.
You better come, no matter what.
